verdict.rationale: The evidence covers click maps, campaign reports with link clicks, custom reports grouped by audience or timeframe, and shop/order data import. None of it documents attributing signups or revenue to specific emails or automation flows. Importing order data and building custom reports are adjacent building blocks, not the attribution capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks
